name: Due South
description: Constable Benton Fraser, an officer of the Royal Canadian Mounted Police, is attached to the Canadian consulate but works with Chicago Police Department to solve crimes.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: When Robert Fraser is killed in a 'hunting accident' in the Northwest Territories, his son Benton investigates, which ends up leading him to Chicago, where he pairs up with a smart-aleck cop named Ray to find his father's killer.

videos.title: Ride Forever
videos.overview: A documentary on the making of all three seasons of Due South. Featuring contributions from Paul Gross, David Marciano, Callum Keith Rennie, George Bloomfield, Beau Starr, Ramona Milano, Catherine Bruhier, Daniel Kash, Tony Craig, Deb Drennan, and Gordon Pinsent.

videos.title: Southbound
videos.overview: A documentary on Due South filmed for ITV and broadcast in December 2006, featuring interviews with the cast and crew.

videos.title: Free Willie
videos.overview: Fraser convinces Ray to help him save a young purse snatcher named Willie from the thugs that are after him.

videos.title: Diefenbaker's Day Off
videos.overview: Fraser agrees to help six-year-old Lucy, who is worried about all the accidents her father Charlie is having.

videos.title: Manhunt
videos.overview: Julie Frobisher enlists Fraser's help in finding her father, who has gone missing one week before his retirement.

videos.title: They Eat Horses, Don't They?
videos.overview: Fraser realises that the meat in a local market is actually horsemeat and he and Ray discover a number of recent poisonings in the Chicago area.

videos.title: Pizzas and Promises
videos.overview: After Lenny the pizza boy gets his car stolen, Fraser goes undercover as a used car salesmen to take down a ring of car thieves.

videos.title: Chinatown
videos.overview: Fraser overhears a crime while in Chinatown and he and Ray learn that the kidnapping was an attempt to stop the Chinese mob from taking over the neighborhood.

videos.title: Chicago Holiday (1)
videos.overview: Fraser agrees to babysit the teenage daughter of a Canadian diplomat while they are in Chicago, but Christina turns out to be harder to handle than he thought.

videos.title: Chicago Holiday (2)
videos.overview: Fraser chases Christina around Chicago, even ending up in a BDSM nightclub while they try to elude the man who is looking for Christina.

videos.title: A Cop, a Mountie, and a Baby
videos.overview: Fraser convinces Ray to let him track down an abandoned baby's real parents rather than automatically turn the infant over to CPS.

videos.title: The Gift of the Wheelman
videos.overview: Fraser realises that the only witness to a bank robbery committed by Santa Clauses is protecting his father and tries to save both the man and his son.

videos.title: You Must Remember This
videos.overview: Ray meets the woman of his dreams after he is the victim of a hit and run but soon realises she's an international arms dealer.

videos.title: A Hawk and a Handsaw
videos.overview: Fraser saves a man from suicide at a local psychiatric hospital and soon realises that his words aren't merely the rantings of a mental patient.

videos.title: An Eye for an Eye
videos.overview: Fraser tries to do a good deed by encouraging senior citizens to stand up for their rights but spurs one elderly man into vigilantism.

videos.title: The Man Who Knew Too Little
videos.overview: Fraser and Ray try to escort pathological liar Ian MacDonald back to Canada but there's a certain criminal element that is very interested in him not crossing the border.

videos.title: The Wild Bunch
videos.overview: Diefenbaker is ordered to be exterminated after he bites a dog catcher but Fraser is determined to find out why his gentle wolf bit a human.

videos.title: The Blue Line
videos.overview: Fraser and Ray try to protect his childhood friend Mark, now a famous hockey player, but Fraser is disappointed to learn that it's become all about the money for Mark.

videos.title: The Deal
videos.overview: Fraser and Ray investigate the robbery of a church poor-box after mobster Frank Zuko makes some demands to the higher power, but both Ray and Fraser feel for the thief, who was driven out of business by Zuko.

videos.title: An Invitation to Romance
videos.overview: Fraser is forced to follow a woman all over the city after she gets an envelope that wasn't meant for her which enrages the woman's extremely jealous fiancé.

videos.title: Heaven and Earth
videos.overview: Fraser uses his amazing sense of smell to track down Garret, a homeless man believed to have information about the kidnapping of a young woman. Ray worries that Francesca and Fraser slept together.

videos.title: Victoria's Secret (1)
videos.overview: Fraser reunites with Victoria, the only woman he ever loved but was forced to arrest years earlier. Their time is limited, however, as Victoria's old partner is after her, looking for the money he believes she stole from him.

videos.title: Victoria's Secret (2)
videos.overview: Fraser ends up in hot water when Jolly ends up dead and Victoria disappears, with Fraser the only suspect in Jolly's murder.

videos.title: Letting Go
videos.overview: Fraser, Ray and Diefenbaker investigate a series of crimes while Fraser is recovering from a gunshot wound. Fraser tries to forget about Victoria.

videos.title: North
videos.overview: A plane crash blinds Fraser and strands the pair in the wilderness. Fraser and Ray's vacation to Canada to rebuild his father's cabin doesn't go as planned when it turns out the pilot of their airplane is actually an escaped felon. The felon jumps out of the plane, causing it to crash. Fraser is blinded in the crash, and eventually loses the use of his legs. Ray tries to carry Fraser out of the woods, and the two cops still have to catch the felon, while dealing with the ghosts of their two fathers.

videos.title: Vault
videos.overview: During a bank robbery, Fraser and Ray are trapped in a time-locked, water-filled vault. After Ray is declared dead due to a mix-up with the insurance company, Fraser and Ray go to Ray's bank, where the end up in the middle of a robbery, running into someone they've met before...Morgan. Fraser and Ray lock themselves in the vault and Fraser sets off the sprinkler system, hoping to hit the criminals with a tidal wave of water. Meanwhile, Frannie is waiting in Ray's car outside, and enters the building, thereby becoming a hostage.

videos.title: Witness
videos.overview: Ray is jailed for contempt of court; Fraser gets arrested to protect him.

videos.title: Bird in the Hand
videos.overview: Fraser must see that a federal witness comes safely to trial.

videos.title: The Promise
videos.overview: A teenage thief's life is put in danger when she steal an appointment book which could destroy a powerful senator's career, and Fraser and Ray have to save her.

videos.title: Mask
videos.overview: When valuable aboriginal masks are stolen from a museum, Fraser and Ray have to find the culprits.

videos.title: Juliet is Bleeding
videos.overview: Ray is convinced that he's found Guardino's killer in mafia boss Frank Zuko, but is torn when he realises he's the brother of his childhood sweetheart, Irene Zuko.

videos.title: One Good Man
videos.overview: Fraser rallies the tenants to do something about the current situation, but when they get the landlord's attention, he evicts them all. In order to fix what he did, Fraser then goes in front of city council.

videos.title: The Edge
videos.overview: Ray and Fraser team up with Anita Cortez to protect their countries diplomats at a NAFTA convention, and a series of mishaps land Fraser with envelope duty, until he and Cortez can put aside their mutual enmity to work together.

videos.title: Starman
videos.overview: Ian MacDonald claims aliens kidnapped his girlfriend Audrey as he was about to propose. Ray and Fraser reluctantly investigate, and learn that Audrey is involved in a shady government organization.

videos.title: We are the Eggmen
videos.overview: Ray and Francesca fight over a winning lottery ticket...she wants half the winnings because she put in half the money, and he says it's all his money because he purchased the winning ticket solely with his own money. After accidentally creating an accident with a local farmer, Fraser is sued by him, and later learns he's created a special brand of egg that everyone wants.

videos.title: Some Like It Red
videos.overview: Fraser goes undercover as a woman at a girls' school after Ray's ex-girlfriend comes to him for help. Ray, meanwhile, worries that he turned his ex into a nun.

videos.title: White Men Can't Jump To Conclusions
videos.overview: A teen takes the rap for a drug dealer but Fraser and Ray are determined to prove his innocence.

videos.title: All the Queen's Horses
videos.overview: Terrorists take a train carrying a group of singing mounties.

videos.title: Body Language
videos.overview: An exotic dancer tells about mobsters taking over strip joints.

videos.title: The Duel
videos.overview: A paroled killer leaves clues about his next victims for Ray.

videos.title: Red, White or Blue
videos.overview: Terrorists strap Fraser and Ray to a bomb.

videos.title: Flashback
videos.overview: Fraser has amnesia after being thrown from a speeding van driven by diamond thieves and forgets everything -- his name, his identity, and the license plate of the speeding van. Ray tries to prod Fraser's memory by recounting some of their times together.

videos.title: Burning Down the House
videos.overview: Fraser returns from vacation to a blazing apartment and a new partner, Stanley Ray Kowalski.

videos.title: Eclipse
videos.overview: Kowalski stakes out a crypt to face his nemesis; Internal Affairs investigates Vecchio.

videos.title: I Coulda Been a Defendant
videos.overview: Fraser and Kowalski try to reward a reluctant hero but blow his protected-witness cover.

videos.title: Strange Bedfellows
videos.overview: The team guards a council candidate courting Kowalski's ex-wife, Stella.

videos.title: Seeing Is Believing
videos.overview: Thatcher, Kowalski, and Welsh all see a murder at a local mall, and the daughter of a wealthy man is implicated in the killing.

videos.title: Bounty Hunter
videos.overview: A pretty bounty hunter with a big gun and three kids charms Fraser into helping her.

videos.title: Mountie & Soul
videos.overview: A neighborhood could turn into a battlefield after a gang member dies in a boxing match.

videos.title: Spy vs. Spy
videos.overview: Fraser's elderly chess partner claims he is a deep-cover secret agent waiting to be activated.

videos.title: Asylum
videos.overview: Kowalski is framed for the murder of a crime boss. Fraser protects him by letting him stay at the consulate which is official Canadian territory. While Ray and Turnbull are stuck at the consulate, Fraser tries to find the real killer.

videos.title: Perfect Strangers
videos.overview: Fraser must find a flight attendant's killer before her father does.

videos.title: Dead Guy Running
videos.overview: Ray finds a corpse hidden in the interrogation room wall.

videos.title: Mountie on the Bounty (1)
videos.overview: The case of a murdered sailor, $100 million in gold bullion and a ghost ship in the Great Lakes Triangle tests feuding Fraser and Kowalski.

videos.title: Mountie on the Bounty (2)
videos.overview: The case of a murdered sailor, $100 million in gold bullion and a ghost ship in the Great Lakes Triangle tests feuding Fraser and Kowalski.

videos.title: Dr. Longball
videos.overview: Welsh's brother calls for big-city backup to catch baseball-team saboteurs.

videos.title: Easy Money
videos.overview: Fraser's childhood mentor(Tom Quinn)arrives in Chicago with the hope of stopping a U.S. company from constructing a hydro dam that will leave his northern village under water.

videos.title: The Ladies' Man
videos.overview: Ray has misgivings when Beth Botrelle, a woman he arrested years ago for murdering her police officer husband,is scheduled to be executed. Accompanied by Fraser, he tracks down evidence that proves her innocense.

videos.title: Mojo Rising
videos.overview: After a voodoo priest dies in a cell, his body disappears from the morgue.

videos.title: Dead Men Don't Throw Rice
videos.overview: A murder-for-hire business has a unique body disposal system...funeral caskets.

videos.title: Odds
videos.overview: When a beautiful poker player (Denny Scarpa) is arrested, she cuts a deal with the Feds. Fraser is planted in a high stakes game of cards and Ray must come to his rescue when the poker game gets rough.

videos.title: Mountie Sings the Blues
videos.overview: A Canadian country-western singer gets death threats.

videos.title: Good for the Soul
videos.overview: Ray arrests a mob boss for minor assault, and Fraser is determined to make it stick.

videos.title: A Likely Story
videos.overview: When a pretzel vendor is gunned down in the park, Fraser investigates the crime, with surprising results.

videos.title: Say Amen
videos.overview: Fraser and Ray investigate after witnessing men in a white limousine abduct a teen girl from a shopping mall.

videos.title: Hunting Season
videos.overview: A female Mountie who comes to Chicago after two murder suspects has a strange attraction for Fraser.

videos.title: Call of the Wild (1)
videos.overview: Fraser and Kowalski pursue an arms dealer to the Yukon, where they join forces with Buck Frobisher's (Leslie Nielsen) detachment.

videos.title: Call of the Wild (2)
videos.overview: Fraser and Kowalski pursue an arms dealer to the Yukon, where they join forces with Buck Frobisher's detachment.
